title: Setoff Per Diem for Open Earlier-Month Days — Closing and Funding Interest Accounting
content:
**Definitions.** For Closing and Funding funding-month interest, the open earlier-month days are the days of the charge collected at closing (the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date) that no prepaid interest refund naming that charge has returned, never fewer than zero. Refunds of every kind count here: any refund entry naming that charge returns its days.

**Rule.** The setoff per diem of an open earlier-month day is set as follows: where open earlier-month days remain and the charge collected at closing used a daily amount above the funding-month per diem, it is the funding-month per diem, and the rest of that day's daily amount is not set off and stays on the charge collected at closing; where open days remain and the charge's daily amount is at or below the funding-month per diem, it is the charge's daily amount; otherwise there is no setoff per diem.

| Open earlier-month days | Charge's daily amount vs. funding-month per diem | Setoff per diem |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | above | the funding-month per diem (the rest of each day's amount is not set off and stays on the charge collected at closing) |
| one or more | equal | the charge's daily amount |
| one or more | below | the charge's daily amount |
| none | any | none |

## Cases (hypothetical; funding-month per diem 71.23)

| Charge: days, daily amount | Refunds naming the charge | Open days | Setoff per diem |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 days at 74.10 | none | 4 | 71.23 (2.87 a day not set off, staying on the charge collected at closing) |
| 4 days at 69.86 | none | 4 | 69.86 |
| 4 days at 69.86 | 1 day returned | 3 | 69.86 |
| 4 days at 69.86 | 4 days returned | 0 | none |
